chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'ibn 'Abdillah and 'Abdillah 'ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ahmad 'ibn Muhammad 'ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from his father, from 'Abd al-'Azim 'ibn 'Abdillah 'ibn al-Hasan, from al-Husayn 'ibn al-Hakam al-Nakha'i, from Abi Hammad al-A'rabi, from Sadir al-Sayrifi, who said:

We were with Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) when a young man mentioned the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to him, 'For every step a servant takes towards it, Allah records for him one good deed and erases one bad deed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for taking a step towards the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Jawad (peace be upon him) underscores the profound spiritual economy of Ziyarah, where physical movement towards the shrine translates directly into divine forgiveness. This specific reward of one good deed for one step reflects the Shia emphasis on the sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt's resting places as portals of mercy, linking the pilgrim's physical effort to the erasure of sins.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, and from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid Al-Barqi, from his father, from ‘Abdil ‘Ażīm ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ḥasan, from Ḥusain ibn Ḥakam Al-Nakh’i, from Abī Ḥammād Al-A’rābi, from Sadīr Al-Sayrafi, who said:

We were with Abī Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) when a young man mentioned the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Abū Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said to him, “Allāh will register one good deed and erase one bad deed for every step taken by those who go to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
